title: Template: a 32 s example promo (replace everything in this file per video)

brief.what: What the video is for, in one line
brief.where: Where it plays: LinkedIn, Reels, the website, a screen at an event
brief.cta: The one action: Make your first one today at example.com

music.note: placeholder.py makes this click-free 120 BPM loop so the template renders and mixes with no downloads and no key. Replace it with a generated or licensed track, measure it with beats.py and copy period, first_beat, bpm and segments here. pluck_notes: F4 A4 C5 F5, retune to the song's key.

voice.style: Warm, cheerful and playful voice inviting a friend to try something fun. Natural, lively but relaxed pace, a smile in the voice, no radio-announcer tone.
voice.note: provider: auto (OPENROUTER_API_KEY, else GEMINI_API_KEY, else none), openrouter, gemini or none. none = no paid voice: use placeholder.py voice for a scratch track, record or import your own vo/<name>.wav, or leave the lines out for a music-only video. Model names change: check your provider's current TTS model list.
